# Base data fields (this dataset: cn_data / csi300)

Only these `$` fields exist in the installed dataset. **Do not reference any field not listed here.** Prefix each with `$` in expressions.


| field | note |
|---|---|
| `$change` | daily change |
| `$close` | close price (adjusted) |
| `$factor` | adjustment factor |
| `$high` | high |
| `$low` | low |
| `$open` | open price (adjusted) |
| `$volume` | volume |

## ⚠️ Absent fields — DO NOT USE

The stock Alpha158/Alpha360 handlers reference `$vwap`, but **this dataset does not contain it.** Any feature or expression using `$vwap` resolves to NaN and will silently degrade the model. Avoid entirely.


## Label convention (from the qlib templates)

The prediction label is the 2-day-ahead forward return: `Ref($close, -2)/Ref($close, -1) - 1`. Because the label horizon is 2 days, any leakage-safe CV must embargo >= 2 days (ADR 0001 §7 v1).
